independentReview.scope: EV-003 protocol card only, on the three exact source hashes below; no execution approval or comparison win.
independentReview.finding: Six families, independent unseen tasks, repeated blocks, equal resources, native Inspect logs, missing-is-not-a-win, no score-optimizing retry and no user quota are covered. Coarse sample thresholds and missing concrete dataset/run inputs remain explicitly disclosed.

checks.scope: Existing historical EV-002 preflight/result constraints plus one new assertion guarding EV-003 preregistered inputs. Not agent quality, an executable new suite or scorer validation.

decision: Six task families, repeated unseen tasks, separately reported human preference, initiative, assistance, time, usage and recovery. Product thresholds are Eva's declared criteria, not thresholds prescribed by Inspect. Native Inspect logs/scorers remain authoritative; no separate runtime or result format added.
limits: Concrete unseen dataset, curator and sealed run settings must still be established independently before execution.
Small discrete samples have coarse thresholds; repeated blocks are not a statistical guarantee across arbitrary tasks.
No benchmark result, competitive win or full product acceptance follows from these document/contract checks.
Existing dirty CO-003 source and project-goal changes were preserved, not included implicitly.
